name: @cavalry/desktop
description: Cavalry local-first desktop finance app powered by Tauri.
author: Cavalry

scripts.dev: npm run build:host && cargo tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:host
scripts.sidecar:prepare:mac: npm run build:host && node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.sidecar:prepare:mac:intel: npm run build:host && node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.sidecar:prepare:windows: npm run build:host && node scripts/build-sidecar.mjs --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.tauri:build: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare && cargo tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:mac: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare:mac && cargo tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:mac:intel: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare:mac:intel && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.tauri:build:windows: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare:windows && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --config src-tauri/tauri.bundle.conf.json
scripts.tauri:release:mac: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare:mac && npm run release:config && cargo tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.tauri:release:mac:intel: npm run licenses:runtime && npm run sidecar:prepare:mac:intel && npm run release:config && cargo tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin --config src-tauri/tauri.release.conf.json
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests vite.*.config.mjs vitest*.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:renderer
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test && npm run sidecar:smoke
